claims.claim: With fixed source defaults, gallery-only open-set fitting does not improve over R2 in the evaluated Pets conditions.
claims.scope: Eight cells across two fixed, image-disjoint same-domain pools, matched or DTD galleries and one or five support examples per class.
claims.what_would_falsify_it: A reproducible positive paired effect over R2 in an asserted cell, or a source/identity/permission mismatch invalidating the comparison.

claims.claim: Strong inlier ranking coexists with substantial total task-external gallery weight in the evaluated matched-gallery transfer.
claims.scope: Final fitted weights under the source-default gallery transfer; conditional descriptive statistics.
claims.what_would_falsify_it: Incorrect class membership or weight accounting, failed prediction replay, or negligible retained external mass in these conditions.

claims.claim: Final-step mass balancing alleviates mismatch degradation but does not close the matched one-shot gap; privileged composition removal gives a separate diagnostic gain.
claims.scope: Retrospective interventions with earlier fitted weights and feature geometry held fixed.
claims.what_would_falsify_it: Mass balancing closes the matched one-shot strong-control gap, oracle filtering gives no diagnostic gain, or original predictions fail exact replay.

claims.claim: A fixed source-trained membership calibrator with prior correction fails the two-direction development-transfer gate and yields no prediction benefit over a same-mass control.
claims.scope: Frozen features; historically exposed DTD and EuroSAT pools; paired one- and five-shot conditions. Separate from the OSLO experiment.
claims.what_would_falsify_it: Different same-mass predictions or a reproducible paired gate pass under the locked protocol, or an invalid source/task comparison.

count_boundary: Four manuscript evidence groups;35reference-only histories do not add independent support to C1-C4.
